jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8007 acceptance gaps (Codex review): (1) The spec is: the chip shows 'connecting' only after 2 missed polls (or 2 missed heartbeats on the run page). Today after two missed polls the project chip renders 'Stale (N s)'. Change BoardLib.chipState and the project.js label so that: before the first good answer -> 'connecting'; good answer within two poll intervals plus slack -> 'Live'; after two missed polls -> 'connecting' (add the age as a title attribute or a small suffix 'connecting (last update N s ago)'); never flips back and forth inside the two-poll window. Do the same for the run page stream state in tools/watch-assets/app.js: 'connecting' after two missed heartbeats. Keep liveness() unchanged for other callers. (2) Add a test with a fake slow server read/write: a fake res whose write() returns false twice (back-pressure) and a slow snapshot read (a getRunSnapshot that resolves after a delay driven by fake timers): the stream stays open, heartbeats still go out, and the client state stays Live while pings arrive within two intervals. Update tests/board-live-chip.test.mjs. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Tests: node:test, fake timers/injected now, no real waiting. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-live-chip.test.mjs tests/board-live.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs tests/watch-ui.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests only use these files for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the FULL suite after integration.
